title-group.article-title: Treatment S for condition U: a systematic review

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: A previous review included four trials [8–11] and searched databases up to 2015 [1].

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: The date of the last search was 14 February 2021.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: We included five trials [3–7] with 640 participants.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Our review included two more trials than the previous one [2, 12].
